meta.name: retro
meta.description: Generate a project- and plan-specific sprint retrospective by reviewing session logs, gathering user feedback, and comparing plan vs built. No cross-project generalization or candidate lessons. Use after /develop reports a sprint DONE, or when the user explicitly asks to retro a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据会话记录自动生成项目冲刺回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次冲刺后需要快速生成回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate sprint retrospectives from session logs automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick retrospectives after each sprint

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取会话日志和用户反馈，对比计划与实际完成的内容，生成一份针对特定项目或计划的冲刺回顾报告。
howto.when: 当 /develop 报告一个冲刺完成，或用户明确要求对某个计划进行回顾时触发。

say.text: 帮我回顾一下这个冲刺的计划完成情况。
say.note: Claude 会读取日志并生成回顾报告。

say.text: 对当前项目做一次冲刺回顾。
say.note: Claude 会要求提供计划文件路径或自动选择。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads session logs and user feedback, compares plan vs built, and generates a sprint retrospective report specific to a project or plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when /develop reports a sprint DONE, or when the user explicitly asks to retro a plan.

say_en.text: Review the completion of this sprint plan.
say_en.note: Claude reads logs and generates a retrospective.

say_en.text: Do a sprint retrospective for the current project.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for plan file path or pick interactively.
